parts.name: Toggle
parts.description: A `<button>` that is pressed or not, with `aria-pressed`. Inside a toggle group the group owns its state; inside a toolbar it is one of the toolbar's items.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Whether the toggle is pressed. Pass it with `onPressedChange` to control it. Ignored inside a toggle group.

props.name: defaultPressed
props.description: Whether the toggle is pressed at first, when it isn't controlled.

props.name: onPressedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the toggle is pressed. Inside a group it runs before the group's `onValueChange`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: A disabled toggle doesn't change, and its `onClick` and `onPressedChange` aren't called. It is also disabled when its group is.

props.name: value
props.description: What the toggle stands for in a toggle group's `value`. Give one to every toggle in a group.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the toggle is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-pressed
dataAttributes.description: Present while the toggle is pressed.
